lines.speaker: Verlaine
lines.text: [Breathing heavily] This is Officer Verlaine. Personal log. I don't know the date. MUTHUR's clock is wrong.

lines.speaker: Verlaine
lines.text: I'm in Engineering. C1. The doors are jammed — I did it on purpose. I don't think that'll hold.

lines.speaker: Verlaine
lines.text: I have to say it out loud so someone knows. W-Y knew. They knew what was in that container. We were the delivery vehicle.

lines.speaker: Verlaine
lines.text: Chen is gone. Security is gone. I don't know about Kowalski. I haven't heard anyone else in... I don't know how long.

lines.speaker: Verlaine
lines.text: The thing — it's not stupid. It learns. It figured out the vents in the first day. It figured out the lights by the third.

lines.speaker: Verlaine
lines.text: I'm sending everything I have to MUTHUR's buffer. The logs. The W-Y emails. Everything. Someone has to know.

lines.speaker: Verlaine
lines.text: [Long pause] If you're a crew member and you're hearing this — don't go to B3. Don't go to C2. And don't trust W-Y. Not even a little.

lines.speaker: Verlaine
lines.text: [Sound: impact against door — three times, heavy]

lines.speaker: Verlaine
lines.text: Oh no. Oh no oh no—
